   342	static exr_result_t
   343	validate_channels (
   344	    exr_context_t f, exr_priv_part_t curpart, const exr_attr_chlist_t* channels)
   345	{
   346	    exr_attr_box2i_t dw;
   347	    int64_t          w, h;
   348	
   349	    if (!channels)
   350	        return f->report_error (
   351	            f,
   352	            EXR_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT,
   353	            "Missing required channels attribute to validate against");
   354	    if (!curpart->dataWindow)
   355	        return f->report_error (
   356	            f,
   357	            EXR_ERR_NO_ATTR_BY_NAME,
   358	            "request to validate channel list, but data window not set to validate against");
   359	
   360	    if (channels->num_channels <= 0)
   361	        return f->report_error (
   362	            f, EXR_ERR_FILE_BAD_HEADER, "At least one channel required");
   363	
   364	    dw = curpart->data_window;
   365	    w  = (int64_t) dw.max.x - (int64_t) dw.min.x + 1;
   366	    h  = (int64_t) dw.max.y - (int64_t) dw.min.y + 1;
   367	
   368	    for (int c = 0; c < channels->num_channels; ++c)
   369	    {
   370	        int32_t xsamp = channels->entries[c].x_sampling;
   371	        int32_t ysamp = channels->entries[c].y_sampling;
   372	
   373	        if (xsamp < 1)
   374	            return f->print_error (
   375	                f,
   376	                EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   377	                "channel '%s': x subsampling factor is invalid (%d)",
   378	                channels->entries[c].name.str,
   379	                xsamp);
   380	        if (ysamp < 1)
   381	            return f->print_error (
   382	                f,
   383	                EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   384	                "channel '%s': y subsampling factor is invalid (%d)",
   385	                channels->entries[c].name.str,
   386	                ysamp);
   387	        if (dw.min.x % xsamp)
   388	            return f->print_error (
   389	                f,
   390	                EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   391	                "channel '%s': minimum x coordinate (%d) of the data window is not a multiple of the x subsampling factor (%d)",
   392	                channels->entries[c].name.str,
   393	                dw.min.x,
   394	                xsamp);
   395	        if (dw.min.y % ysamp)
   396	            return f->print_error (
   397	                f,
   398	                EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   399	                "channel '%s': minimum y coordinate (%d) of the data window is not a multiple of the y subsampling factor (%d)",
   400	                channels->entries[c].name.str,
   401	                dw.min.y,
   402	                ysamp);
   403	        if (w % xsamp)
   404	            return f->print_error (
   405	                f,
   406	                EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   407	                "channel '%s': row width (%" PRId64
   408	                ") of the data window is not a multiple of the x subsampling factor (%d)",
   409	                channels->entries[c].name.str,
   410	                w,
   411	                xsamp);
   412	        if (h % ysamp)
   413	            return f->print_error (
   414	                f,
   415	                EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   416	                "channel '%s': column height (%" PRId64
   417	                ") of the data window is not a multiple of the y subsampling factor (%d)",
   418	                channels->entries[c].name.str,
   419	                h,
   420	                ysamp);
   421	    }
   422	
   423	    return EXR_ERR_SUCCESS;
   424	}

   426	/**************************************/
   427	
   428	static exr_result_t
   429	validate_part_type (exr_context_t f, exr_priv_part_t curpart)
   430	{
   431	    // TODO: there are probably more tests to add here...
   432	    if (curpart->type)
   433	    {
   434	        const char *expectedtype = NULL;
   435	        exr_result_t rv;
   436	
   437	        // see if the type overwrote the storage mode
   438	        if (f->is_singlepart_tiled)
   439	        {
   440	            if (f->is_multipart || f->num_parts > 1)
   441	                return f->print_error (
   442	                    f,
   443	                    EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   444	                    "Multipart files cannot have the tiled bit set");
   445	
   446	            if (curpart->storage_mode != EXR_STORAGE_TILED)
   447	            {
   448	                curpart->storage_mode = EXR_STORAGE_TILED;
   449	
   450	                if (f->strict_header)
   451	                {
   452	                    return f->print_error (
   453	                        f,
   454	                        EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   455	                        "attribute 'type': Single part tiled flag set but not marked as tiled storage type");
   456	                }
   457	            }
   458	        }
   459	
   460	        if (curpart->storage_mode == EXR_STORAGE_SCANLINE)
   461	            expectedtype = "scanlineimage";
   462	        else if (curpart->storage_mode == EXR_STORAGE_TILED)
   463	            expectedtype = "tiledimage";
   464	        else if (curpart->storage_mode == EXR_STORAGE_DEEP_SCANLINE)
   465	            expectedtype = "deepscanline";
   466	        else if (curpart->storage_mode == EXR_STORAGE_DEEP_TILED)
   467	            expectedtype = "deeptile";
   468	
   469	        if (expectedtype && 0 != strcmp (curpart->type->string->str, expectedtype))
   470	        {
   471	            if (f->mode == EXR_CONTEXT_WRITE) return EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR;
   472	
   473	            if (f->strict_header)
   474	            {
   475	                return f->print_error (
   476	                    f,
   477	                    EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   478	                    "attribute 'type': Type should be '%s' but set to '%s', believing file flags",
   479	                    expectedtype,
   480	                    curpart->type->string->str);
   481	            }
   482	            else
   483	            {
   484	                /* C++ silently changed this */
   485	                rv = exr_attr_string_set (
   486	                    f, curpart->type->string, expectedtype);
   487	
   488	                if (rv != EXR_ERR_SUCCESS)
   489	                    return f->print_error (
   490	                        f,
   491	                        EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   492	                        "attribute 'type': Mismatch between file flags and type attribute, unable to fix");
   493	            }
   494	        }
   495	    }
   496	
   497	    /* NB: we allow an 'unknown' storage type of EXR_STORAGE_UNKNOWN
   498	     * for future proofing */
   499	    if (curpart->storage_mode == EXR_STORAGE_LAST_TYPE)
   500	    {
   501	        return f->print_error (
   502	            f,
   503	            EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   504	            "Unable to determine data storage type for part");
   505	    }
   506	
   507	    return EXR_ERR_SUCCESS;
   508	}

   512	static exr_result_t
   513	validate_tile_data (exr_context_t f, exr_priv_part_t curpart)
   514	{
   515	    if (curpart->storage_mode == EXR_STORAGE_TILED ||
   516	        curpart->storage_mode == EXR_STORAGE_DEEP_TILED)
   517	    {
   518	        const exr_attr_tiledesc_t* desc;
   519	        const int                  maxtilew = f->max_tile_w;
   520	        const int                  maxtileh = f->max_tile_h;
   521	        const exr_attr_chlist_t*   channels = curpart->channels->chlist;
   522	        exr_tile_level_mode_t      levmode;
   523	        exr_tile_round_mode_t      rndmode;
   524	
   525	        if (!curpart->tiles)
   526	            return f->print_error (
   527	                f,
   528	                EXR_ERR_MISSING_REQ_ATTR,
   529	                "'tiles' attribute for tiled file not found");
   530	
   531	        desc    = curpart->tiles->tiledesc;
   532	        levmode = EXR_GET_TILE_LEVEL_MODE (*desc);
   533	        rndmode = EXR_GET_TILE_ROUND_MODE (*desc);
   534	
   535	        if (desc->x_size == 0 || desc->y_size == 0 ||
   536	            desc->x_size > (uint32_t) (INT_MAX / 4) ||
   537	            desc->y_size > (uint32_t) (INT_MAX / 4))
   538	            return f->print_error (
   539	                f,
   540	                EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   541	                "Invalid tile description size (%u x %u)",
   542	                desc->x_size,
   543	                desc->y_size);
   544	        if (maxtilew > 0 && maxtilew < (int) (desc->x_size))
   545	            return f->print_error (
   546	                f,
   547	                EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   548	                "Width of tile exceeds max size (%d vs max %d)",
   549	                (int) desc->x_size,
   550	                maxtilew);
   551	        if (maxtileh > 0 && maxtileh < (int) (desc->y_size))
   552	            return f->print_error (
   553	                f,
   554	                EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   555	                "Width of tile exceeds max size (%d vs max %d)",
   556	                (int) desc->y_size,
   557	                maxtileh);
   558	
   559	        if ((int) levmode < EXR_TILE_ONE_LEVEL ||
   560	            (int) levmode >= EXR_TILE_LAST_TYPE)
   561	            return f->print_error (
   562	                f,
   563	                EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   564	                "Invalid level mode (%d) in tile description header",
   565	                (int) levmode);
   566	
   567	        if ((int) rndmode < EXR_TILE_ROUND_DOWN ||
   568	            (int) rndmode >= EXR_TILE_ROUND_LAST_TYPE)
   569	            return f->print_error (
   570	                f,
   571	                EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   572	                "Invalid rounding mode (%d) in tile description header",
   573	                (int) rndmode);
   574	
   575	        for (int c = 0; c < channels->num_channels; ++c)
   576	        {
   577	            if (channels->entries[c].x_sampling != 1)
   578	                return f->print_error (
   579	                    f,
   580	                    EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   581	                    "channel '%s': x subsampling factor is not 1 (%d) for a tiled image",
   582	                    channels->entries[c].name.str,
   583	                    channels->entries[c].x_sampling);
   584	            if (channels->entries[c].y_sampling != 1)
   585	                return f->print_error (
   586	                    f,
   587	                    EXR_ERR_INVALID_ATTR,
   588	                    "channel '%s': y subsampling factor is not 1 (%d) for a tiled image",
   589	                    channels->entries[c].name.str,
   590	                    channels->entries[c].y_sampling);
   591	        }
   592	    }
   593	
   594	    return EXR_ERR_SUCCESS;
   595	}
